title: The final quarter of 2026 is expected to see softer bauxite flows
section_path: The final quarter of 2026 is expected to see softer bauxite flows
section_path_text: The final quarter of 2026 is expected to see softer bauxite flows
summary:
Main
Chinese front-loading is expected to have run its course, pointing to softer bauxite flows in 2026 Q4. Global bauxite flows increased by 2.8% y/y in September. Flows arriving in China increased by 21.2% y/y in September
Flows arriving in the UAE fell by over 60.0% in September.

children.title: Front loading leads to a weaker final quarter outlook
section_path: Front loading leads to a weaker final quarter outlook
children.section_path_text: Front loading leads to a weaker final quarter outlook
children.summary: Global bauxite flows are expected to soften in Q4 as Chinese front-loading eases and Guinea's export restrictions begin to constrain supply. September's surge in Chinese arrivals contrasts with weakening demand across India and the Arabian Gulf, where adequate stocks and ongoing regional disruption limit the potential for a recovery.
